teaser.en: A forest shrub believed to do its growing at night, when no one is watching.
teaser.sw: Kichaka cha msituni kinachoaminika kukua usiku, wakati hakuna anayekiona.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka cha tsakani ambacho atu anaamini kukala chinakula usiku, wakati takuna mutu anayelola.

summary.en: Mkula usiku is a forest shrub of the acanthus family with white tubular flowers. Its name, 'grow by night', records a belief about how it grows.
summary.sw: Mkula usiku ni kichaka cha msituni cha familia ya Acanthaceae chenye maua meupe yenye umbo la mrija. Jina lake, 'kua usiku', linahifadhi imani kuhusu jinsi kinavyokua.
summary.dg: *Mkula usiku* ni chitsaka cha tsakani cha jamii ya *acanthus*, chenye maruwa mereru ga umbo ra mrija. Dzinare, 'unakula usiku', rinaonyesa imani ya atu kuhusu vira unavyokula.

about.en: *Mkula usiku* is a shrub of the forest understorey, in the acanthus family. *Whitfieldia* species have opposite, smooth leaves and clusters of white tubular flowers, each held in a large, papery, often pale calyx.
about.sw: *Mkula usiku* ni kichaka kinachoota chini ya miti mikubwa msituni, katika familia ya Acanthaceae. Spishi za *Whitfieldia* zina majani laini yanayoota kwa jozi zinazotazamana, na vishada vya maua meupe yenye umbo la mrija, kila ua likiwa ndani ya kikombe kikubwa cha ua (kaliksi) kilicho kama karatasi na mara nyingi chenye rangi hafifu.
about.dg: *Mkula usiku* ni chitsaka cha photsi ya tsaka, photsi ya mihi mire, cha jamii ya *acanthus*. Aina za *Whitfieldia* zina makodza laini ganayomera mairi-mairi ganayolengana, na mabunda ga maruwa mereru ga umbo ra mrija. Chila ruwa rinakala ndani ya makodza ga kondze ga ruwa (*calyx*) makulu, membamba dza karatasi, na mara nyinji ga rangi ngushu-ngushu.

where.en: It grows in the shade of moist and coastal forest. The species is found in both West and East Africa.
where.sw: Kinaota kivulini katika misitu yenye unyevu na misitu ya pwani. Spishi hii inapatikana Afrika Magharibi na Afrika Mashariki.
where.dg: Unamera pephoni kahi ya matsaka ga jeke-jeke na ga pwani. Aina ihi inaphahikana Afrika Magharibi na Afrika Mashariki.

culture.en: Pakia records the belief that this plant grows at night, which is where its name comes from.
culture.sw: Pakia anaandika imani kwamba mmea huu hukua usiku, na hapo ndipo jina lake lilipotoka.
culture.dg: Pakia anaandika imani ya kukala mmea uhu unakula usiku, na dzinare rinatuluka phapho.

names.en: *Mkula usiku* means 'grow by night': the plant is believed to grow (*kula*) at night (*usiku*). No other language shares the name, and there is no English or Swahili name in the sources. Pakia spells the species name *Whitfieldia elongate*.
names.sw: *Mkula usiku* maana yake ni 'kua usiku': mmea huu unaaminika kukua (*kula*) usiku (*usiku*). Hakuna lugha nyingine inayotumia jina hili, na vyanzo havitoi jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili. Pakia anaandika jina la spishi kama *Whitfieldia elongate*.
names.dg: Mana ya *mkula usiku* ni 'unakula usiku': atu anaamini kukala mmea uhu unakula (*kula*) wakati wa usiku (*usiku*). Takuna luga yanjina inayohumira dzina hiri, na maandiko tagana dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili. Pakia anaandika dzina ra aina ihi *Whitfieldia elongate*.

reason.sw: Barleria, mmea mwingine wa familia ya Acanthaceae
reason.dg: Barleria, mmea wanjina wa jamii ya *acanthus*

reason.en: Also named for how it grows: 'quick'
reason.sw: Nao umepewa jina kutokana na jinsi unavyokua: 'haraka'
reason.dg: Nao dzinare rinatuluka kpwa vira unavyomera: 'upesi'

reason.en: Named for blooming fast in a new field
reason.sw: Umepewa jina kwa kuchanua haraka katika shamba jipya
reason.dg: Dzinare rinatuluka kpwa kulavya maruwa upesi kpwenye munda muphya
